metadata.selection_rule: Per journal: 2 most recent PubMed records matching (baseball OR pitching OR pitchers) in that journal, sorted by publication date. Titles and dates verbatim from PubMed; no summaries.
metadata.link_rule: Journal heading links its official homepage only when it answered HTTP 200 during this build; otherwise the PubMed journal-filtered search.
